# Studio Young Designs — AI Knowledge Summary

> Studio Young Designs is a premier luxury interior design, custom joinery, and turnkey residential execution studio headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded in 1981 by Dhanesh Samant and Geeta Samant, the atelier operates its own in-house woodcraft manufacturing facility and has completed over 700+ luxury residential projects across South India.

## Business Details
- **Entity Name**: Studio Young Designs
- **Founding Year**: 1981 (45+ Years of Excellence)
- **Founders**: Dhanesh Samant & Geeta Samant
- **Headquarters / Studio Address**: No.105, Parvathi Plaza, Richmond Rd, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025, India
- **Phone**: +91 99025 99515 / +91 78295 02213
- **Email**: info@studioyoungdesigns.com
- **Website**: https://www.studioyoungdesigns.com
- **Service Areas**: Bengaluru (Richmond Town, Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, Sadashivanagar, HSR Layout, Dollar Colony, Jayanagar), Chennai, Hyderabad, and South India.

## Primary Services & Capabilities
1. **Modular Kitchens**: Custom island, parallel, L-shaped, and straight kitchens engineered with Blum/Hettich German hardware, natural wood veneers, marine-grade plywood, quartz countertops, and concealed storage mechanisms.
2. **Custom Walk-in Wardrobes**: Bespoke floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, sliding door systems, hinged acrylic/glass wardrobes, integrated LED illumination, island jewelry dressers, and solid wood joinery.
3. **Living Room Interiors**: Custom media consoles, acoustic wooden wall paneling, false ceiling design, luxury furniture fabrication, marble accent walls, and spatial layout planning.
4. **Turnkey Residential Interiors**: Complete end-to-end luxury home interiors (apartments, villas, penthouses) covering layout space planning, civil modifications, electrical routing, custom fabrication, and white-glove installation.
5. **Woodwork & Carpentry Atelier**: Master craftsmanjoinery using natural teak, quarter-sawn oak, American walnut, rosewood, natural wood veneers, and non-toxic low-VOC finishes.
